a9c81ec342934505.title: Michael Blaustein
a9c81ec342934505.desc: Michael Blaustein is one of the fastest rising stand up comedians working today. His viral stand up comedy clips have amassed over 900 Million views across all social media platforms. He has sold out venues across the world, most recently closing out his successful 2025 tour year with over 70,000 tickets sold. When he’s not on the road, he’s co-hosting the chart topping hit comedy podcast Stiff Socks with Trevor Wallace, which has over 70 Million downloads. Michael has also worked with brands such as Manscaped, Liquid Death, and BetterHelp. Now he returns to the stage for the final leg of his wildly successful Taste Me Tour, giving fans one last chance to catch this set live.

a9c39e4e04dc475b.title: Fortune Feimster
a9c39e4e04dc475b.desc: Affable, charismatic and one of a kind, Fortune Feimster is a standup comedian, writer and actor who uses her confessional comedy to bring people together. Through laughter and storytelling, Fortune shows audiences of all ages, backgrounds, and sexual orientations that common ground is only a joke or two away. Viewers really got to know Fortune through her first Netflix special, “Sweet & Salty,” which was nominated for a Critics Choice Award. With her last special “Good Fortune” and her Live Laugh Love Tour she expands further into her storytelling brand of comedy, hilariously delving into love, relationships, sexuality and shared experiences with Southern charm and the perspective of someone who grew up in the 1980s. She’s your funniest cousin who isn't afraid to entertain the masses with tales of her good fortune, insecurities, and faux pas, including meeting her spouse in a parking lot, falling in love and her extravagant proposal that didn’t quite go as planned. Now streaming on Netflix, Good Fortune has earned praise from both fans and critics with the LA Times naming it to their Best of List for 2022 and also scored a nomination at the Critics Choice Awards. a99e657a19ea19f6.title: Dan Whitlam
a99e657a19ea19f6.desc: Dan Whitlam stands as a rising luminary in the music world, captivating audiences with his soulful voice and poignant lyrics that weave a tapestry of raw emotions. From TikTok, where he narrates the intricacies of twenty-something life through rap and spoken word, to the iconic stages of London, Dan’s unique ability to encapsulate heartfelt sentiment has garnered admiration far and wide. Praised by notable artists like Fred Again… and Arlo Parks, Dan’s work has struck a chord within the industry, and his magnetic presence caught the attention of the esteemed fashion brand Hermes, who titled him their resident poet. Under the label of Needwant, his singles—including the latest release, “Satellite,” a powerful collaboration with Julia Church—demonstrate his artistic versatility and commitment to innovation. Previous releases, like the evocative “Juliette” with its stunning Tega Alexander-directed music video, have amassed millions of views on TikTok, solidifying Dan’s impact across platforms. His repertoire also includes tracks like “Young Minds,” “Lights Down,” “Quick Intimacy,” and “Button Up,” each an artistic gem showcasing his distinctive style and multifaceted talent. By…

a92b208e9d462810.title: Book Club for Adults — In-Person Program
a92b208e9d462810.desc: Montserrat, a talented sound editor in 1990s Mexico City, is secretly in love with her best friend, faded soap star Tristán. When they meet cursed horror director Abel Urueta, he convinces them to help complete a mysterious unfinished film involving occult magic and Nazi sorcery. But as they investigate, Montserrat is haunted by a dark presence and Tristán sees his dead ex-girlfriend. Together, they must uncover the film’s supernatural secrets before the curse consumes them. Join us for a discussion of Silver Nitrate, by Silvia Moreno-Garcia. Copies of the book are available at the library for checkout. For Adults.
